{{Quote|&mdash;the assassinations today of Senator Nehal and her aide&mdash;|A fragmented recording of Albathius|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
An '''individual''' served as the aide of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Nehal]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and was [[Death/Legends|assassinated]] alongside the senator. After Nehal's death, [[Albathius]]&mdash;an operative of the [[Star Cabal]]&mdash;gave a speech in which he spoke of the two's assassinations.
